scholarships.title: Beca Interna Postdoctoral - Convocatoria Becas 2026 (CONICET)
scholarships.official_source: CONICET - Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas, Argentina

eligibility: Candidatas/os que deseen perfeccionar su formación académica y desarrollar tareas de investigación
Haber aprobado la tesis doctoral antes de la fecha establecida para el inicio de la beca
Haber realizado la entrega definitiva de los ejemplares de la tesis doctoral o la defensa de la misma al momento de la presentación
Postular a la Comisión Asesora correspondiente a su disciplina
existing.eligibility_summary: Candidates who hold a completed and defended doctoral thesis and who want to develop research activities, applying to a CONICET Advisory Commission aligned with their field.
requirements: Have defended the doctoral thesis, or delivered the final copies, before submitting
Submit through the electronic system described in the official presentation instructivo for the 2026 call
Frame the research plan against the call's priority themes list and priority regions/thematic areas matrix
documents: The documentation listed in the official bases for Becas Internas Postdoctorales (BASES-PD-2026) and its presentation instructivo, both linked from the call page
Any supporting documents required by the presentation instructivo, including digital letters of endorsement
application_method: Electronic submission following the official 'Instructivo para la presentación de solicitudes' published with the 2026 call
existing.selection_notes: The call states that within each Advisory Commission 70 per cent of the available places go to proposals matching the priority themes or the priority regions and thematic areas, and the remaining 30 per cent to eligible applicants in order of merit within that Commission. If a Commission does not receive enough eligible applications meeting those criteria, the leftover places are not reassigned to other Commissions and stay pending allocation in a second round.
existing.best_fit: Doctorate holders seeking three years of funded postdoctoral research in Argentina, particularly in a strategic sector or knowledge area on CONICET's priority list for 2026.
existing.notes: The 2026 call as a whole provides 1,000 internal doctoral places, 300 internal doctoral-completion places and 800 internal postdoctoral places. Applications for the doctoral lines ran in July and August 2026 and are closed; this record covers the postdoctoral line, whose window opens on 18 February 2027.
